heroHeadline: Largest-Ever U.S. Cyclosporiasis Outbreak Shows Signs of Slowing: 27,557 Combined Cases, 2 Dead
heroSubtitle: The multistate outbreak traced to Taylor Farms de México iceberg lettuce served at Taco Bell and sold under Walmart's Marketside brand has sickened 10,930 people across 17 states (27,557 combined with other season-wide clusters). Michigan, the epicenter, reports weekly case growth slowing sharply as the state's chief medical executive says 'the worst is behind us,' even as FDA expands onsite sampling at Mexican lettuce growers and congressional scrutiny of Taylor Farms continues.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
